governing_rule: Tracks retain domain-specific units and claim ceilings. Do not compute or publish a pooled score, scalar trust score, or universal assurance level.

external_comparators.comparison_rule: Keep dataset/protocol rows separate. These are paper-reported results, not independently reproduced and not directly comparable to Luminous runs until acquisition, split, label and evaluator protocols are matched.
external_comparators.limitation: Curated protocol results do not establish broad industrial emitter generalization or physical RF acquisition qualification.
